connector.name: Manager.io MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Manager.io bookkeeping: read-first with opt-in scoped task and write tools
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package manager-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the flumpiey account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MANAGER_API_URL
env.description: Manager API base URL (include /api2 when required)

env.name: MANAGER_API_KEY
env.description: Access token from Manager Settings (sent as X-API-KEY)

env.name: MANAGER_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES
env.description: Comma-separated delete scopes (never implied by write scopes)
